get.summary: Retrieves a collection of potential search terms based on the value passed as term.
get.description:
Collection is of the form {sitename}_{lang_code}.  Currently, {sitename} is always "cgov" and {lang_code} may
be either "en" (English) or "es" (Español).

parameters.name: collection
parameters.description: The search collection/strategy to use. This defines the ES template to use.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The language to use. Only "en" and "es" are currently supported.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: The search term to use as a basis for search terms

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The maximum number of results to return.

200.description: A Suggestions collection of Suggestion objects.

get.summary:
Provides an endpoint for checking that the various services which make up the API
(and thus the API itself) are all in a state where they can return information.

200.description:
The contents of SearchController.HEALTHY_STATUS ('alive!') if
            all services are running. If unhealthy services are found, APIErrorException is thrown
            with HTTPStatusCode set to 500.

get.summary: Gets the results of a search

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: The language to use. Only "en" and "es" are currently supported.

parameters.name: term
parameters.description: The search term to search for

parameters.name: from
parameters.description: The offset of results to retrieve

parameters.name: size
parameters.description: The number of items to retrieve

parameters.name: site
parameters.description: An optional parameter used to limit the number of items returned based on site.

get.summary:
Provides an endpoint for checking that the various services which make up the API
(and thus the API itself) are all in a state where they can return information.

200.description:
The contents of SearchController.HEALTHY_STATUS ('alive!') if
            all services are running. If unhealthy services are found, APIErrorException is thrown
            with HTTPStatusCode set to 500.

Suggestions.description:
Container for the the list of potential search terms returned
by the SiteWideSearch.AutosuggestController.

results.description: The set of potential search items.

total.description: The total number of matching search terms available.

term.description: The Backend ID for this item

SiteWideSearchResults.description: Represents the results of a sitewide search operation.

results.description: Array of SiteWideSearchResult objects matching the search. May be empty.

totalResults.description: The total number of results matching the search criteria.

SiteWideSearchResult.description: Represents a Single Site-Wide Search Result

contentType.description: Gets the content type of this result if there is one

description.description: Gets the description of this result
